page.layout: One page of text in a single column. No margin notes. Running head at top, page number at top left. Heading "Conclusio." centred, then paragraphs, then heading "Exercitatio XXI I." centred, an italic title, a paragraph with a drop cap, and a last line ending in a hyphen with catchword at bottom right.

main_text.head: Conclusio.
main_text.p: Hæc si amicus recte meditetur, sperare te, eum adversarii strophas & calumnias nihil moraturû. Addatur ἐπιδιώξις[?]: quatuor postrema absurda tantum esse convitia responsione indigna.
Excusetur prolixitas 1. quia disputationis amplitudo te breviorem esse non permiserit.
II. quia ipse ad singula ἀνασκευαστικῶς[?] postula-verit.
Consilium: Clamoribus & calumniis ejus doctrinam fidei & pœnitentiæ Evangelii propriam constanter opponat.
main_text.head: Exercitatio XXI I.

head.i: Paraphrasis historiæ de Altari exstructo à Rubenitis ad Iordanem Iosuæ 22. scribatur phrasi latina.

main_text.p: Narretur 1. dimissio duarum & dimidiæ tribuum post occupatam Cananæam: & oratio Iosuæ, primo collaudantis obedientiam & operam fratribus præstitam: secundo permittentis reditum in Gileaditidem: tertio exhortantis ad Legis & cultus divini observantiam. quarto Benedicentis ac munera dantis ex præda discedentibus.

page.notes: The Greek words after "Addatur" and "Petitio" are uncertain and marked [?]. The numeral in "Exercitatio XXI I." is printed with a space and is copied as printed. The line "II. quia ipse" is set in small type and may be "11." in print. The catchword "danem" is partly cut off at the right edge.
